mapper.sql: id, document_id, chunk_index, content, estimated_tokens, chunk_metadata, index_version
mapper.select: select from knowledge_chunk where document_id = #{documentId} order by index_version, chunk_index
select from knowledge_chunk where document_id = #{documentId} and index_version = #{indexVersion} order by chunk_index

insert into knowledge_chunk (document_id, index_version, chunk_index, content, estimated_tokens, chunk_metadata) values (#{documentId}, #{indexVersion}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{estimatedTokens}, cast(#{metadataJson} as jsonb)) returning id
mapper.delete: delete from knowledge_chunk where document_id = #{documentId} and index_version = #{indexVersion}
